recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add redundant Device text for FHIR-15516; use a new tracker if OO later wants to change Device.type versus DeviceDefinition.classification guidance or GTIN terminology-system treatment.
issue_request: FHIR-15516 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification OO resolution for R5. It asked to remove Device guidance that could be read as allowing GTINs, reference numbers, or catalog numbers to be sent in Device.identifier, because Identifier is intended for actual identifiers of a specific device instance.
initial_application: Commit 63ae64a20a96b5e193e6f0f11f509c1f7cb617bf pre-applied GF#15516 in March 2018 by replacing the older Device Types and Device Identifiers notes with the current Device Identifier and Device Type section. Jira later marked the issue Applied/Published after noting that the Device/DeviceDefinition separation put the issue to rest.
additional_context: Both Device and DeviceDefinition are active build resources. Current Device notes, Device.identifier comments, Device.type definition, and Device/DeviceDefinition scope text preserve the intended distinction. Related FHIR-15512 sent broader GTIN terminology handling to THO/UTG rather than core source, and later FHIR-29312 identifier clarification reinforces the same Device.identifier boundary.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current source already says Device.identifier is only for actual identifiers of a specific device instance and directs type-identifying values to Device.type, with Device/DeviceDefinition source covering the kind-versus-instance boundary.

related_jiras.note: Related GTIN code-vs-identifier discussion was resolved no-change for core, with terminology-system handling delegated to THO/UTG.
Later published Device/DeviceDefinition identifier-relationship clarification reinforces that Device.identifier is for instance identifiers and that type-identifying values should use Device.type.
